description: This file defines the `ChainingInterceptor` class, which implements Hibernate's `Interceptor` interface. Its purpose is to maintain and invoke a chain of multiple interceptors during Hibernate session operations, allowing for layered behavior customization such as logging, validation, or other data handling features across Hibernate entity lifecycle events.

classes.name: ChainingInterceptor
classes.description: A composite Hibernate interceptor that chains multiple interceptors, invoking each in sequence to allow layered behavior during entity lifecycle events.

methods.name: addInterceptor
methods.description: Adds a new interceptor to the chain, preventing self-addition to avoid infinite loops.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Invokes the onDelete method on all chained interceptors.

methods.name: onFlushDirty
methods.description: Invokes the onFlushDirty method on all chained interceptors, returning true if any interceptor reports a change.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Invokes the onLoad method on all chained interceptors, returning true if any interceptor reports a change.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Invokes the onSave method on all chained interceptors, returning true if any interceptor reports a change.

methods.name: postFlush
methods.description: Delegates post-flush events to all chained interceptors.

methods.name: preFlush
methods.description: Delegates pre-flush events to all chained interceptors.

methods.name: isTransient
methods.description: Determines if an entity is transient by querying all chained interceptors and combining their responses.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Returns the first non-null result from chained interceptors for entity instantiation.

methods.name: findDirty
methods.description: Aggregates dirty property indices from all interceptors, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the first non-null entity name from chained interceptors.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity instance from the first interceptor that provides it.

methods.name: afterTransactionBegin
methods.description: Delegates after transaction begin event to all interceptors.

methods.name: afterTransactionCompletion
methods.description: Delegates after transaction completion event to all interceptors.

methods.name: beforeTransactionCompletion
methods.description: Delegates before transaction completion event to all interceptors.

methods.name: onPrepareStatement
methods.description: Chains SQL statement modifications across all interceptors.

methods.name: onCollectionRemove
methods.description: Delegates collection removal event to all interceptors.

methods.name: onCollectionRecreate
methods.description: Delegates collection recreation event to all interceptors.

methods.name: onCollectionUpdate
methods.description: Delegates collection update event to all interceptors.
